DODGE GRAND CARAVAN PROMOTIONAL VEHICLE DECALS

When it comes to advertising there are countless ways you can promote a business or brand. In most cases, people tend to go for online advertising which has been proven to be a bit aggressive and less effective as compared to the other ways to push a brand or a product. Among all the available alternatives to reach a wider audience, there is one that hides in plain sight and only a few people are aware of its non-aggressiveness and value for the money. That non-aggressive yet extremely effective way of advertising is Vehicle Decals. As opposed to digital advertising, vehicle decals have the potential to last for years and reach a much wider audience.

As people are getting aware of this great way to advertise, we at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have been receiving a lot of requests for vehicle decals. Recently we installed promotional decals on an existing client’s Dodge Grand Caravan 2011. The client had worked with us in the past when we did a partial wrap for his Mercedes Sprinter. At that time, it was a wrap intended for promotional purposes as well. This time, the client wanted to use all the available real estate on his Dodge Grand Caravan 2011 to promote his brand.

The customer owns a business named ‘KCS Group Ltd. Certified Electrical Contractor’. As the name suggests, the business is all about going to someone’s house or business location to provide a service. So, it was a brilliant idea to get vehicle decals because the Dodge Grand Caravan 2011 will be going places and people will be looking at it. The van is basically a moving billboard and in many ways, that’s a lot better than the ones that just stay still. Additionally, vehicle decals are very cost-effective considering their lifetime and maintenance.

About the decals, the client initially wanted to get Magnetic Vinyl Decals on his Dodge Grand Caravan 2011. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we respect our client’s vision and preferences. However, we believe it is our duty to make the customer aware of all the possible options and risks with what they’re choosing to go for. After that, the client is the one who eventually calls the shots.

Since he wanted Magnetic Vinyl Decals, our installers advised him to go for more reliable standard Vinyl Decals. We explained all the demerits of getting Magnetic Decals as opposed to Regular Vinyl Decals such as the risk of magnets getting weak over time or peeling off of the vehicle when it is going above a certain speed. The client greatly appreciated our installers offering their expert advice and expressing a concern that was in his best interest. Upon receiving the advice, the customer did some thinking and decided to get Standard Vinyl Decals for his Dodge Grand Caravan 2011.

The client wanted decals on several areas including the hood, the sides, the back window, and the trunk of his Dodge Grand Caravan 2011. The hood, sides, and trunk had regular Vinyl Decals. However, he chose to go with perforated decals for the back window. Perforated decals are a special type of vehicle decals that have holes in them to make them partially see-through. The perforated decals that we used had a 60:40 ratio. 60% being the vinyl and 40% being the holes. These types of decals are legal, but we advise that you contact your insurance company to confirm whether they’re acceptable or not.

Our team took on this job with the same enthusiasm as we do for every other job we get. Our installers have more than a decade of experience wrapping vehicles and they treat the vehicle with the utmost care. The client, like when he worked with us the last time, left with complete satisfaction.

We’ve attached some pictures of the Dodge Grand Caravan, before and after getting decals on this page.
